gloss: moving in; transfer (to a new school, area, etc.)

definitions.gloss: moving in; registering as a new resident
definitions.explanation: The act of officially moving into a new municipality or area and registering at the local ward or city office.

definitions.gloss: transfer; transferring in (to a new school or workplace)
definitions.explanation: Entering a new school or organization as a transfer, not from the beginning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}→転入届：09811_tennyuutodoke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}したら→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧{14日以内|じゅうよっかいない}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}→転入届：09811_tennyuutodoke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit the move-in registration within 14 days of moving.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{転入|てんにゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I completed the move-in procedures at the city hall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転入生|てんにゅうせい}→転入生：25867_tennyuusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}する→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧。
⟦{二学期|にがっき}→二学期：23891_nigakki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{転入|てんにゅう}してきた。
examples.english: I transferred in starting from the second semester.

examples.japanese: {転入|てんにゅう}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}して→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}い→通う：01217_kayou⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I passed the transfer exam and started attending the new school.

notes:
A key administrative and school term. When moving between municipalities in Japan, residents must submit a ⟦{転出届|てんしゅつとどけ}→転出届：09810_tenshutsutodoke⟧ (move-out notice) at their old address and a ⟦{転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}→転入届：09811_tennyuutodoke⟧ (move-in notice) at the new one.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}→転入届：09811_tennyuutodoke⟧: move-in registration form
- {転入|てんにゅう}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: move-in procedures
- ⟦{転入生|てんにゅうせい}→転入生：25867_tennyuusei⟧: transfer student
- {転入|てんにゅう}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: transfer entrance exam
- {転入|てんにゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to move in; to transfer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{転出|てんしゅつ}→転出：25698_tenshutsu⟧: moving out — the opposite, leaving a municipality or school
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し: moving (house) — the general act of relocating, without the administrative nuance
- ⟦{転校|てんこう}→転校：03444_tenkou⟧: school transfer — specifically changing schools, subset of sense 2
- ⟦{入居|にゅうきょ}→入居：08630_nyuukyo⟧: moving in (to a dwelling) — focuses on entering a specific residence, not municipal registration
